points.text: 1 (drink of water causes) increase in blood water potential / AW ;
3 causes decrease in release of ADH (into blood in first hour) ;
5 (so) decrease in blood water potential / blood water potential returns to set point ;
6 causes increase in release of ADH ;
1 communication – nervous system: action potential / impulse and endocrine system: hormone ;
2 nature of communication – nervous system: electrical (and chemical) and endocrine system: chemical ;
3 mode of transmission – nervous system: neurone and endocrine system: blood ;
4 response destination – nervous system: muscle and endocrine system: target, organs / tissue / cells ;
5 transmission speed – nervous system: fast(er) and endocrine system: slow(er) ;
6 location of effect – nervous system: specific / localised and endocrine system: (can be) widespread ;
7 response speed – nervous system: fast(er) and endocrine system: slow(er) ;
8 duration of effect – nervous system: short-lived / temporary and endocrine system: can be long-lasting / permanent ;
